record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: For an Anosov flow on a compact Riemannian manifold whose stable bundle has an invariant splitting and fast stable foliation W^s_+, what are the invariant ergodic measures for W^s_+?

evidence.quote: The distribution E s + integrates to the fast stable foliation W s + . The following is a nonlinear analog of the Ragunathan’ s ques tion about clas-siﬁcations of measures invariant under unipotent ﬂows: QUESTION 15 (F . Ledrappier). Describe the invariant ergodic measures for the fast stable foliation W s + .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\phi_t : M \to M$ be a smooth Anosov flow on a compact Riemannian manifold $M$, with hyperbolic splitting $TM = E^s \oplus E^0 \oplus E^u$, where $E^0$ is the one-dimensional bundle tangent to the flow and $E^s$, $E^u$ are the stable and unstable bundles. Suppose that the stable bundle admits a $D\phi_t$-invariant continuous splitting $E^s = E^s_- \oplus E^s_+$ such that vectors in $E^s_+$ are contracted strictly faster (under the forward flow) than vectors in $E^s_-$. Assume that $E^s_+$ is integrable, and let $W^s_+$ denote the resulting "fast stable" foliation of $M$, whose leaves are smooth submanifolds tangent to $E^s_+$.

Describe (classify) all Borel probability measures on $M$ that are invariant and ergodic under the holonomy action of the foliation $W^s_+$ — i.e., the transverse-quasi-invariant measures on $M$ which are invariant under the equivalence relation generated by lying in the same leaf of $W^s_+$, and which are ergodic for this equivalence relation.

This is intended as a nonlinear analog of Ratner's theorem on classification of measures invariant under unipotent flows.
artifact.category_tag: Anosov flows and invariant foliation measures
artifact.status_search_result: A web search reveals significant related work on invariant measures for stable/horocyclic foliations of Anosov flows (Babillot–Ledrappier measures, equilibrium-state rigidity, Ledrappier–Young properties, unique quasi-ergodicity for horocyclic foliations), but no full classification of invariant ergodic measures for the fast stable subfoliation $W^s_+$ in the general Anosov setting was found. The problem appears to remain open in the generality stated.

status_evidence.title: Invariant measures for the stable foliation on negatively curved periodic manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies invariant measures for stable and strong stable Anosov foliations, Busemann functions, horospheres, reversible and harmonic measures, and ergodicity.
status_evidence.claim: Related but partial results exist on classifying invariant measures for stable foliations.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity of equilibrium states and unique quasi-ergodicity for horocyclic foliations
status_evidence.snippet: For topologically mixing metric Anosov flows, horocyclic foliations are uniquely quasi-ergodic under suitable Hölder hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress addresses related horocyclic/strong-stable cases, but not the general fast-stable subfoliation classification.

status_evidence.title: Invariant family of leaf measures and the Ledrappier–Young property for hyperbolic equilibrium states
status_evidence.snippet: Connects equilibrium states with conditional measures on unstable leaves via Ledrappier–Young.
status_evidence.claim: Work continues on leaf-measure classification, indicating the general question is not fully resolved.
